title: Creating an untracked part is refused once the user can no longer delete
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role D, with Part Library & Inventory — View, Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit, Part Library & Inventory — Delete and See Financial Data, so user D starts with the right to delete parts.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user D, at the test location with role D.
  • Use two browser windows: window 1 signed in as the Admin, window 2 (a private window) signed in as user D.
  • Use a part number for a new part, part A, that no part or Part Library entry uses yet.
  • Start window 1 on role D's Edit Role page (Roles & Permissions), with nothing changed yet.
  • Start window 2 on the Inventory page, on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. In window 2, click New Inventory Part.
  2. In window 2, type a description in the Description field.
  3. In window 2, type part A's part number in the Part Number field.
  4. In window 2, pick any category in the Category field.
  5. In window 2, type 5.00 in the Cost field.
  6. In window 2, click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  7. In window 1, untick Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit.
  8. In window 1, untick Part Library & Inventory — Delete.
  9. In window 1, untick See Financial Data.
  10. In window 1, untick every permission in the Settings group.
  11. In window 1, click Save.
  12. In window 2, click Save.
  13. In window 1, click Parts in the top bar.
  14. In window 1, click Inventory in the left menu.
  15. In window 1, type part A's part number in the Search box.
  16. In window 1, click the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • New Inventory Part opens for user D.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 3:

  • Part Number reads part A's part number.

Step 4:

  • The category is picked.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $5.00.

Step 6:

  • The switch turns off and Min and Max are hidden. Do not save yet.

Step 7:

  • The Create & Edit box is unticked.

Step 8:

  • The Delete box is unticked.

Step 9:

  • The See Financial Data box is unticked.

Step 10:

  • Every Settings permission is unticked.

Step 11:

  • Role D is saved with only Part Library & Inventory — View left in the Part Library and Inventory group: user D now cannot delete inventory parts.

Step 12:

  • An access error appears saying user D is not allowed to do this (access denied), and the part is not saved.

Step 13:

  • Window 1 shows the Parts left menu.

Step 14:

  • Window 1 shows the Inventory page on the Active tab.

Step 15:

  • No part A is listed on the Active tab.

Step 16:

  • No part A is listed on the Inactive tab either: no untracked part was created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S8-N1: “If a user without the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission tries to create an untracked part by any route, the request is refused with an access denied error.”
  • S8-R15: “The system accepts a status change, a tracking change and an untracked part from exactly the users it accepts an inventory part delete from today.”
  • Story 8, context note: “Context note: S8-N1 to S8-N3 hold for a user who cannot delete inventory parts today. The system checks that access itself, so hiding the controls is not the only protection.”
